name: Layout morph
description: You sit over a screen recording in a card, a round bubble, a tall side panel or the full frame, and change layout mid-video: the box glides, resizes and rounds into the next layout in 0.7 s while a dark panel slides in or out, with a short real whoosh on each change.
when: Screen + camera videos where the user asks to change layout mid-video: small while the screen matters, big when they talk to the lens.
needs: a take with a camera and a screen file
the plan: each change's second in the cut and its layout (card, bubble, side, full), with a corner for card and bubble
the centre of the face in the camera, in its pixels
the edit's size and frame rate
